notes.title: Beta v3 release
notes.content:
Hey! I hope everything is going well for everyone!
We're kicking off the year 2022 with the [b]biggest update to date[/b], which includes numerous improvements to how the game can be played. It also incorporates elements that should have been in the game but weren't a priority previously.
We worked hard for the [b]last 5 months[/b] to add these features, make the game more engaging, and, most importantly, introduce fresh content that can be played for countless hours.

[h1]New feature – Grabbing players[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227167/12719338cef280f91347ab84c9e2dd4d7e62eb44.png[/img]

Everyone can agree that grabbing other people and pushing them off a cliff is hilarious. Which is why this feature was always in our minds when designing the game. It has now been implemented and is functioning flawlessly. It can also be used to assist someone who is having difficulty climbing a wall.
We had a great time testing that feature, and we hope you will too.


[h1]New feature – Knockout by impact[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227167/a5ea8638b64f227fd17adbe055b2862531d9a1fc.gif[/img]

What would a physics game be without the ability to be knocked out? We added that if you are hit in the head with enough force, your character would be knocked out for a few seconds and fall to the ground.

Each map has its own set of settings that determine what can cause players to be knocked out.
For example, in [b]Box Run[/b], only other players can do it, while in other modes, it may only be objects on the map or both.

Please don't hit yourself in the head too hard!


[h1]New game mode – Don’t Fall From The Platform (DFFTP)[/h1]
It was about time we added a new game mode. [b]Don't Fall From The Platform (DFFTP)[/b] is a game mode in which you must jump from one platform to another while avoiding falling down. The platforms gradually collapse, and your goal is to be the last one standing.

It is strongly advised to utilize the previously mentioned new features and combat other players in order to win.

Below is [b]a short GIF[/b] from development builds demonstrating how the new features can be used to win.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227167/33a05342096997b085d9f6d7916c3d3ccd9d7522.gif[/img]

[h2]New map – Middle of the sea[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227167/4cd8c38b04a884d825365afed0bfed2bf275438a.png[/img]

[b]Middle of the sea[/b] was the first map made for the new game mode [b]Don’t Fall From The Platform (DFFTP)[/b]. It's a map with 25 wooden platforms in the center of what appears to be a beautiful sea. A little island and a large skull island full of mystery can be found in the background.

Oh, and there's a ship with a couple cannons firing at the platforms every few seconds, so pay attention!


[h2]New map – Neon Abyss[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227167/1bd7b5b2909f5c4ffa98281aa5c5582a6d4b4ad8.png[/img]

Take a trip to the void of [b]Neon Abyss[/b], a new [b]Don't Fall From The Platform (DFFTP)[/b] map with a unique aesthetic design. The map has 37 neon platforms, giving you plenty of room to fight the other players.

This map may not have a cool ship that shoots cannons, but it does change colors over time. Isn't that absolutely fantastic?


[h1]Reworked – Spectator mode[/h1]
The spectator mode has been in the game for a long time, but it wasn't up to standard. It had a lot of bugs and errors, but it's been changed in this update. The first thing we did was create new key binds for changing the spectated player because using arrows was inconvenient. You can now change it with mouse buttons as well.

Another change is that if you reach the end of the list of players, it will cycle to the first player in the list instead of refusing to spectate someone else.

A third significant change was the addition of a HUD that displays the name of the player you're currently spectating.

Aside from that, we optimized it and fixed the majority of the bugs we could find.

[h1]Reworked – Player Movement[/h1]
The player movement system has been completely rewritten to operate as server authoritative. It means that it is now entirely server-side, which eliminates many different kinds of cheating. This change took the majority of our time as it was a challenging and time-consuming task, but it allowed us to add features like grabbing players, knockout by impact, and overall made the game more secure (you can no longer use Cheat Engine to fly through the air or walk at the speed of light).
It is still far from perfect, but we will actively work to improve it with each update.

[h2]Revamped – Winner screen[/h2]
Last but not least, the winner screen has been enhanced. We tweaked the text animations slightly and added some eye-catching confetti.


[h3]Full changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*] Remade player movement system to work as server authoritative movement
[*] Added a new game mode "DFFTP (Don't Fall From The Platform)"
[*] Added a new map "Middle of the sea"
[*] Added a new map "Neon Abyss"
[*] Added an option to grab players
[*] Added a knockout by impact when getting hit in the head with enough force
[*] Added brand-new Spectator HUD
[*] Added a way to change spectated player with mouse buttons
[*] Lobby Browser now displays server's ping once the data is available
[*] Added an option to unequip items
[*] Added Steam Inventory Service integration
[*] Added a thumbnail for Maze Escape maps
[*] Added a check when player joins a server, if the player has the equipped item in his Steam inventory
[*] Added a confetti to the winner screen
[*] Added a tooltip with some info when hovering over player in lobby
[*] Added a button to copy lobby's code
[*] Changed "Freeze" power-up icon
[*] Updated to Unity version 2020.3.25f1
[*] Updated hitboxes
[*] Spawnpoints on Maze Escape are now hidden
[*] Players no longer can spawn on the same spawnpoint
[*] Player names are no longer nicknames set on Steam
[*] Fixed possible error when launching the game when customization was never set before
[*] Fixed game start button being clickable after returning to lobby and not selecting a new map
[*] Fixed killing player on "Western" not working correctly
[*] Fixed boxes on "Western" being ungraspable
[*] Fixed player names not being set correctly
[*] Fixed annoying jitter on clients due to desynchronization
[*] Fixed non-steam items not being applied correctly
[*] Fixed host always falling at the start on Box Run map "Western"
[*] Fixed player still walking when balance is lost
[*] Fixed clients not being put in unbalanced state correctly
[*] Fixed changing spectated player throwing an error
[*] Fixed spawnpoints on Maze Escape not working correctly
[*] Fixed minimap elements being visible in normal view when game ends on Maze Escape
[*] Fixed SteamIDs not being applied correctly when 2 players join at the same time
[/list]

[h1]Few last words[/h1]
This year, we hope to make significant improvements to the game and prepare it for release.
If you've made it this far and are interested in the game, please consider [b]adding it to your wishlist[/b] and [b]following the community hub[/b]. It really helps, and we will be truly thankful. If you have any questions or suggestions, please leave them in the comments section, and we will respond as soon as possible!

Thanks for taking interest in the game,
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/marjobtw/][b][i]Marjo[/i][/b][/url]

notes.title: Beta v2 is out
notes.content:
[h1]Introducing Maze Escape[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227167/d9db12f6eca334928c2c606005b19922be68f555.png[/img]
[b]Maze Escape[/b] is a brand-new game mode in which the goal is to be the first player to escape from a procedurally generated maze.
There are 3 power-ups randomly spawned on the map to help you win:
[list]
[*] Speed - boosts your player speed for 5 seconds
[*] Slowdown - slows every player for 7 seconds
[*] Freeze - freezes random player for 3 seconds
[/list]
The mode is available in 3 variants: 15x15, 25x25 and 50x50


[h1]New Map - Western[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227167/e5eb024a61f2f637096b00264448f1613ae45059.png[/img]
[b]Box Run[/b] got a new wild west themed map - [b]Western[/b]. It's a medium-sized map, perfect for 2-10 players.


[h1]Brand-new Main Menu[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227167/50a88b02d020a79295fd2dbb9849141a3c3341cd.png[/img]
We decided it is time to move on from the old boring main menu look and that it's time to introduce a new, better design for it.
The new main menu contains more colors, new sweet animations which gives it unique look.


[h1]New Player Customization[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227167/7728c287394d0f1ac0b22aa7c622004f50072787.png[/img]
Our new feature, Player Customization, is out. Earn unique hats from playing and equip them to stand out in the game.
This feature is still in beta and with every update, there will be more hats to get.


[h1]Lobby Browser[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41227167/7ed993799b524b0a194af52c6c51a515eb36041a.png[/img]
Introducing [b]Lobby Browser[/b], a new feature to help you find people to play with.
Waiting for a friend? Looking for a new challenge?
Try finding a game using Lobby Browser to get matched against other players, you've never played before!
Using Lobby Browser allows you also to join a game that has its privacy set to "Code-Only".


[h2]Beta v2 full change log[/h2]
+ Complete Main Menu Revamp
+ Complete Lobby Revamp
+ Winner screen Revamp
+ Added brand-new player model
+ Added lobby browser
+ Added lobby creator
└ You can now create Invite-Only, Code-Only and Public lobbies instead of being limited to Friends-Only
+ Added player customization
+ Added basic game settings
+ Added option to change sensitivity
+ Added new game mode "Maze Escape"
└ Mazes are procedurally generated
└ There are 3 map variants: 15x15, 25x25 and 50x50
└ There are 3 available power-ups: Speed, Slowdown and Freeze
+ Added Steam Inventory Service Support
+ Added ping counter under fps counter
+ Added an option to hide the fps/ping counter
+ Added a thumbnail for Box Run's map "Castle"
+ Reworked a thumbnail for Box Run's map "Prototype"
+ Added a keybind to hide the fps/ping counter
* Players now spawn in random positions
* Fixed a vulnerability that could cause someone to pretend to be someone else
* Fixed game not ending when there's 1 player left in Box Run
* Fixed a bug where kicking a player from lobby did not remove him from the player list
* Camera no longer clips through walls
* Players can no longer change their name colors using <color="color"> tags
* Map "Prototype" (Box Run) now has enough spawn points to spawn all the players
* Fixed an error that could be caused by switching spectated player
* Brought back old fps counter
* Player names are no longer nicknames from Steam set by host
* Shadows are now higher quality (will be possible to change shadow quality in the future)
* Fixed winner screen showing player name set on Steam by host


[h2]Beta v2.1 full change log[/h2]
+ Added new Box Run map "Western"
+ Added new animations to the main menu
+ Added an option to limit frames per seconds
+ Lobbies with empty name will now have a name set to "Unnamed Lobby"
* fps/ping counter is no longer visible in future games once it was hidden
* Fixed joining loading animation not showing
* Fixed player being stuck in floor when falling
